title: Lalita Kumari v. Govt. of U.P.

content.caseIdentity: Lalita Kumari v. Govt. of U.P., (2014) 2 SCC 1
content.holding: Registration of FIR is mandatory under Section 154 CrPC (now s. 173 BNSS) if the information discloses commission of a cognizable offence; no preliminary enquiry is permissible in such cases except in 5 defined classes.
content.relevance: Rule of mandatory FIR registration and strict guidelines on preliminary enquiry.
